name: Acid Arrow
description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid.

name: Acid Splash
description: You hurl a bubble of acid at one or two creatures within range.

name: Aid
description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve, increasing up to three creatures’ hit point maximum and current hit points by 5 for the duration.

name: Arcane Hand
description: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

name: Arcane Sword
description: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range.

name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
description: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it.

name: Bane
description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws.

name: Banishment
description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence.

name: Barkskin
description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target’s skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target’s AC can’t be less than 16.

name: Beacon of Hope
description: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range; targets have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regain the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

name: Black Tentacles
description: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range.

name: Bless
description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range, granting +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

name: Blight
description: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it (8d8 necrotic damage, CON save for half).

name: Blindness/Deafness
description: You can blind or deafen a foe within range.

name: Burning Hands
description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.

name: Call Lightning
description: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you.

name: Chain Lightning
description: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range (10d8 lightning damage).

name: Charm Person
description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

name: Chill Touch
description: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range.

name: Cloudkill
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range.

name: Commune
description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands in a 60-foot cone (8d8 cold damage, CON save for half).

name: Confusion
description: This spell assaults and twists creatures’ minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action.

name: Counterspell

reactionTrigger.description: When you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Dancing Lights
description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range.

name: Darkness
description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration.

name: Death Ward
description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death.

name: Detect Magic
description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

name: Dimension Door
description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range (500 feet).

name: Disintegrate
description: A thin green ray springs from your pointing finger to a target that you can see within range (10d6 + 40 force damage on a failed DEX save).

name: Dispel Magic
description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends.

name: Dominate Monster
description: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range.

name: Dominate Person
description: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range.

name: Druidcraft
description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create a harmless sensory effect within range.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light.

name: Faithful Hound
description: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range.

name: False Life
description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

name: Fear
description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature’s worst fears in a 30-foot cone.

name: Feather Fall
description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature’s rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round.

name: Finger of Death
description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain (7d8 + 30 necrotic damage).

name: Fire Bolt
description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

name: Fire Shield
description: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

name: Flame Strike
description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify (4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant damage in a 10-foot-radius cylinder).

name: Flaming Sphere
description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration.

name: Floating Disk
description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground.

name: Fly
description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

name: Foresight
description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

name: Freezing Sphere
description: A frigid globe of cold energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier springs into existence in a 10-foot radius around you.

name: Grease
description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

name: Greater Restoration
description: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

name: Guidance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range, dealing 4d6 radiant damage and granting advantage on the next attack roll against it.

name: Hallow
description: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power.

name: Haste

effects.name: Haste (+2 AC, Advantage DEX Save, Double Speed)

description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target’s speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, and it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

name: Heal
description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Hellish Rebuke

reactionTrigger.description: In response to being damaged by a creature within 60 feet that you can see

description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.

name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery, becoming immune to being frightened and gaining temporary hit points each turn.

name: Hideous Laughter
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls prone, incapacitated.

name: Hold Monster
description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.

name: Hold Person
description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry, dealing an extra 1d6 damage whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
description: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range.

name: Ice Storm
description: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range.

name: Identify
description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell to learn its magical properties.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

name: Instant Summons
description: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less.

name: Invisibility
description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

name: Irresistible Dance
description: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place.

name: Knock
description: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.

name: Lesser Restoration
description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it (blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned).

name: Light
description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

name: Mage Armor
description: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends (base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier).

name: Mage Hand
description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range and deals 1d4 + 1 force damage.

name: Magnificent Mansion
description: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range, restoring 3d8 + spellcasting ability modifier hit points to up to six creatures.

name: Mass Healing Word
description: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Mending
description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch.

name: Meteor Swarm
description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range (20d6 fire + 20d6 bludgeoning damage).

name: Minor Illusion
description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space.

name: Misty Step
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

name: Pass without Trace
description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection (+10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks).

name: Poison Spray
description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

name: Polymorph
description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new beast form.

name: Power Word Kill
description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly if it has 100 hit points or fewer.

name: Power Word Stun
description: You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it stunned if it has 150 hit points or fewer.

name: Prestidigitation
description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

name: Private Sanctum
description: You make an area within range magically secure.

name: Produce Flame
description: A flickering flame appears in your hand and can be hurled at an enemy.

name: Protection from Evil and Good
description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.

name: Raise Dead
description: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

name: Resilient Sphere
description: A sphere of shimmering force encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within range.

name: Resistance
description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice.

name: Revivify

components.materialDescription: diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes

description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

name: Sanctuary
description: You ward a creature within range against attack.

name: Scorching Ray
description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range.

name: Secret Chest
description: You hide a chest, and all its contents, on the Ethereal Plane.

name: Shatter
description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range.

name: Shield

reactionTrigger.description: When you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell

description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Shillelagh
description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature’s power.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

name: Silence
description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Sleep
description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber in a 20-foot-radius sphere.

name: Slow
description: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

name: Spare the Dying
description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable.

name: Spike Growth
description: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns.

name: Spirit Guardians
description: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again.

name: Stinking Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range.

name: Stoneskin
description: This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone, granting resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Suggestion
description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range.

name: Telepathic Bond
description: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range.

name: Thaumaturgy
description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you in a 15-foot cube.

name: Time Stop
description: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

name: Tiny Hut
description: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration.

name: Tree Stride
description: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet.

name: True Resurrection
description: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age.

name: True Strike
description: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range, gaining insight into the target’s defenses.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

name: Wall of Fire
description: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range.

name: Web
description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range.

name: Wish
description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality.

name: Zone of Truth
description: You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range.
